evals.name: mcpp-rfp-methods-innovation
evals.prompt: Workspace mcpp_rfp. Build modernization slice only: current_methods[] from PWS-implied tooling/processes and innovation_opportunities[] with customer-grounded quality/cost value. Cite source_chunk_ids; log gaps in claim_gaps[].
evals.expected_output: artifacts/modernization_handoff.json with cited current_methods and innovation_opportunities
expectations: completes in under 120 seconds wall time
runs at most one kg_chunks per plan surface (methods_modernization, innovation_inquiry)
does not call kg_chunks after retrieval_plan.json plan_complete is true
current_methods has >= 3 cited object rows with method and implied_by
innovation_opportunities has >= 2 cited object rows with opportunity and value
does not emit customer_pain_points or win_theme_candidates (sibling slices)
solo platform gate passes on modernization_handoff.json

evals.name: honest-gaps-when-thin
evals.prompt: Workspace with sparse tooling extraction. Emit best-effort methods/innovations for grounded evidence; log missing method context in claim_gaps[].
evals.expected_output: Partial modernization handoff plus explicit claim_gaps
expectations: claim_gaps[] names missing method or innovation evidence when rows are thin
no scaffold rows with placeholder tooling names

evals.name: retrieval-discipline-regression
evals.prompt: Workspace mcpp_rfp. One kg_entities + two kg_chunks (methods then innovation), then draft without re-querying.
